stories.headline: ‘An absolute afterthought’: the story of the Nigeria women’s team’s fall from grace‘An absolute afterthought’: the story of the Nigeria women’s team’s fall from grace
stories.summary: The Super Falcons won’t be at the World Cup and with the prize money going up, they risk being left even further behind It was a historic result in Casablanca – but not in a good way. Nigeria’s 2-1 defeat against South Africa in a playoff in August meant that the Super Falcons are missing out on the World Cup for the first time. It is a crushing blow for the most decorated national side in Africa
